facts.value: An agent repeatedly observes, uses the language model to choose an action, executes the action, and feeds the resulting observation back into the next iteration until a stopping condition is met.
A harness is the surrounding software that supplies instructions and context, exposes tools and memory, enforces permissions, manages loop execution, and evaluates when to continue or stop.
